The Sword of a Thousand Truths is a fictional legendary sword used in South Park episode #147 "Make Love, Not Warcraft". The weapon is needed to defeat an unspeakably powerful Alliance griefer who mercilessly kills Alliance Players and Blizzard Game Masters.
__NOTOC__ T'chali the Witch Doctor is a jungle troll ghost located in Bloodmaul Ravine in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Sylvanaar Ancient Protectors can be located at Sylvanaar in Blade's Edge Mountains.
Sword of Light is a passive level 10 Retribution paladin ability.
Sylvanaar Sentinels are night elves located in Blade's Edge Mountains.
Symmetry is a mechano-tank located in Rustbolt on Mechagon Island. It is ridden by Prince Erazmin.
Sword Off My Back was an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Tagain is a tauren cloth armor vendor located on the middle rise in Thunder Bluff. During the feast for the Highmountain tauren, she was trapped by the Void.

.]] Taeshalach is the sword of the titan Aggramar. When Sargeras betrayed the Pantheon, Aggramar met him in a duel. When their blades met, it ignited an explosion of fel and arcane that caused both weapons to shatter. As such, only half of Taeshalach remains physically intact, with the other half being made up of flame. In Aggramar's Antorus encounter, Taeshalach could summon fire elementals called the Embers, Flames, and Manifestations of Taeshalach. __NOTOC__
The Tailgunner's Flight Suit is a quest reward from Tailgunner!.
__NOTOC__ Talan Moonstrike is a night elf found in Light's Hammer of Icecrown Citadel. He sells the Tier 10 armor for hunters.

Tally Zapnabber is a gnome quest giver located at Toshley's Station in the Blade's Edge Mountains. He gives quests to Alliance players allowing them to test out his Zephyrium Capacitorium. He has made two clones of himself - Rally Zapnabber, also at Toshley's Station, who he calls his "twin", and O'Mally Zapnabber, at Evergrove, who is known as Tally's "other twin".
Tame Kaliri are kaliri found in Veil Lashh in the Blade's Edge Mountains. They aren't targettable, but can be seen flitting around the village.
Talonclaw, also known as the Eagle Spear and the Spear of the Wild Gods, is the artifact used by survival hunters in World of Warcraft: Legion. The spear allows its wielder to fly while dead.
Tame Clefthooves are clefthooves located in Mok'Nathal Village in Blade's Edge Mountains.

Tank and Spank is the most common type of PvE fight. Tank holds aggro, DPS nuke the mob(s), healers keep the tank alive. The only common complication in fights of this type is aggro - damage dealers must be careful not to generate more threat than the tank. The expression is sometimes used derogatorily, meaning that the essential battle tactics for a boss are pitifully simple outside of perhaps a very visible and avoidable AoE. Occasionally this simplicity is used for gear check fights, so players can be more certain it is simply their equipment that must be brought to par. Examples: Attumen the Huntsman, Patchwerk, Garalon, Sha of Fear, Sha of Pride, , Kromog
Tanaide is a night elf general goods vendor located at Sylvanaar in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Tavok, Hammer of the Empress is a kunchong who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
Tear Armor was one of the pet abilities that only raptors could use.
Tense Unstable Diamond can be purchased for from Aether-tech Master in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Teng of the Flying Daggers sells items in exchange for Valor Points and Shado-Pan Assault reputation, and she also redeems Tier 15 armor tokens.

Tethris Aran is a series of night elven ruins found in northern Desolace just north of Thunder Axe Fortress. The ruins are inhabited only by the wild creatures of Desolace. The night elven settlement that was here was presumably destroyed by the Great Sundering.
Terrorweave Tunic is an epic leather chest armor that drops from Doomwalker in Shadowmoon Valley. It can also drop from Doomwalker in Tanaris during WoW's Anniversary.
Tethik is a lynx found in Mok'Nathal Village in the Blade's Edge Mountains. Tethik accompanied Leoroxx to the first Azerothian Kosh'harg in Razor Hill in Durotar. Tethik can be petted.
Tesla Cannon is an ability used by Baby Winston during a pet battle.
The Bladefist is a one-hand fist weapon. It is well known as the weapon of Kargath Bladefist, Chieftain of the Shattered Hand Clan and self-proclaimed Warchief of the Fel Horde.
The Boomstick is a quality gun. It drops from Anzu, the boss summoned in Sethekk Halls for the Druid Epic Flight Form quest.
The Blade is a mogu assassin known for slathering his blade in a powerful ointment that plays with the mind to slay his enemies. He apparently collects the armor of his enemies as trophies, as well.

The Crimson Dawn is a Sunreavers destroyer south of Hrothgar's Landing and east of The Silver Blade in the southern reaches of the Sea Reaver's Run. It carries Buckets of Fresh Chum for use by members of the Horde in the quest What Do You Feed a Yeti, Anyway? (Horde). During the war against the Lich King, it was manned by Crimson Dawn Sailors who fought the kvaldir back from Icecrown's main shore, and killed a few North Sea Sharks when they weren't fighting.
The Grand Collector appears in Blade's Edge Mountains near the end of the Bash'ir Landing raid, serving as the event's "final boss".
.]] The Immovable Object is an epic-quality shield obtained from the Stormpike Guard faction, or the Frostwolf Clan. It is the counter to The Unstoppable Force.

The Immortal Coil is a sunken Forsaken battleship within the Legion's Fate of the Kelp'thar Forest. It is here Horde adventurers first awaken after being attacked by Ozumat while first traveling to Vashj'ir. Erunak Stonespeaker, the one who saved the adventurer, will be here to help.
The Laughing Axe was a cursed pirate destroyer. It was taken out by fleets sent from the Alliance and Horde garrisons.
The Last Blade is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
__NOTOC__ The Planar Edge is a main-hand specialty axe made by Master Axesmiths who are the only ones who can wield it. It gives a bonus to critical strike rating and attack power.

The Second Prophecy can be found in Grishnath of Blade's Edge Mountains. When approached: :The Voice of the Raven God whispers: Steel your minds and guard your thoughts. The dark wings will cloud and consume the minds of the weak, a flock of thralls whose feet may never leave the ground.

The Silver Blade is a Silver Covenant destroyer south of Hrothgar's Landing and west of The Crimson Dawn in the southern reaches of the Sea Reaver's Run. It carries Buckets of Fresh Chum for use by members of the Alliance in the quest What Do You Feed a Yeti, Anyway? (Alliance). During the war against the Lich King, it was manned by Silver Blade Sailors who fought the kvaldir back from Icecrown's main shore, and killed a few North Sea Sharks when they weren't fighting.

The Skyshredder is a Horde zeppelin that was part of the air fleet formed to fight in the Twilight Highlands along with Spear of Durotar, Heart of Orgrimmar, The Impervious, The Indomitable, and Garrosh's Airship. It was damaged by the twilight dragonflight before it could reach the naval fleet off the west coast of Dragonmaw Port. Survivors led by Captain Krazz established the Krazzworks and repaired The Skyshredder. It was used to attack Highbank.
The Shadow of Gilneas begins a quest chain for worgen characters to obtain their heritage armor. It can be picked up just outside the Stormwind Embassy within Stormwind City after reaching level .
The Thunderspike drops from Gor Grimgut in the Draenethyst Mine in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

The Third Prophecy can be found in Grishnath of Blade's Edge Mountains. When approached: :The Voice of the Raven God whispers: The Old blood will flow once again with the coming of the raven, the return of the darkness in the skies. Scarlet night, and the rise of the old.

The Tank is a siege engine located in Gorgrond. It belongs to Thaelin Darkanvil. The Tank was used again by Thaelin to quickly move through the Molten Core when a piece of the Core was needed to repair the Black Anvil. It fell into lava and was destroyed, though Thaelin said he has backups.

The Spear of Durotar is the flagship of the air fleet that sends to the Twilight Highlands. Horde players board at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara and ride it in the quest. Upon entering the Highlands, Garrosh sends away the protective air support to attack an undefended Alliance fleet. The Spear of Durotar, along with the other zeppelins, is attacked by the twilight dragonflight, led by . Despite fighting the dragons, the Spear and other airships are brought down near Dragonmaw Port.

The Twin Blades of Azzinoth are a weapon set that are wielded by the Lord of Outland, Illidan Stormrage. Equipping both blades awards the Feat of Strength, Warglaives of Azzinoth (achievement). They drop from Illidan Stormrage in the Black Temple.
Thermaplugg's Left Arm is a two-handed axe that gives bonuses to strength and stamina.
Thelett Shaleheart redeems Tier 16 Flexible armor tokens for Alliance players in Shrine of Seven Stars.
.]] The Thrash Blade is a one-hand sword that is most often sought after by Rogues for its ability to grant extra swings.
Thrash is a proc triggered ability which provides a chance to do extra attacks, similar to Windfury Weapon.
Thorium Flight Blade is a quest reward from A Future Task (Alliance).

Thunder Axe Fortress is a stronghold occupied by the Burning Blade cult. The fortress is located in northwestern Desolace and is now led by Kohor. While they have lost the :Hand of Iruxos years ago, they found a way to summon a very powerful demon named Nazargen. If summoned too soon though, he would be weak enough to be dealt with. The fortress is made up of a stronghold, a barracks, a cave and several watch towers.
Threlc is an orc fish vendor located at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Thuk the Defiant spawns when Stasis Chamber Alpha is opened at Bash'ir Landing in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

.]] Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker is the legendary sword once wielded by Prince Thunderaan, Prince of Air. Equipping the sword awards the Feat of Strength, Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker (achievement). It is currently the only legendary weapon that is available to all classes.

Thunderlord Stronghold is a Horde town in the Blade's Edge Mountains. It was the stronghold of the Thunderlord clan until they were transformed into fel orcs, after which it was abandoned. Sometime later the Bladespire clan of ogres took over the ruins, but were driven out by the Horde expeditionary forces who now hold it in honor of the original clan. After the opening of the Dark Portal, Rexxar traveled here in search of his own race. An old orc town hall sits at the center of the stronghold, which is protected by walls and several Mag'har watch towers. The Azerothian orcs brought with them a large pack of dire wolves, which settled down at Jagged Ridge under the leadership of den mother R
The Thunderlord Clan Artifact drops from any of the Bladespire ogres at Bladespire Hold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Thunderlord Clan Sub-Chief can be found in Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains guarding Garm Wolfbrother.
Thunderlord Grunts are level 73 elite guards in Thunderlord Stronghold in Blade's Edge Mountains.

Tier 3 is an armor set that was acquired from the original level 60 version of Naxxramas. This was the first nine-piece set that, in addition to the traditional eight armor slots, also included a tier ring. The replacement Tier 7 sets, which drop from the level 80 version of Naxxramas, use the same models with different color palettes. Acquiring a full eight-piece set awards the Drop Dead, Gorgeous feat of strength. Between and there was no way for players to acquire new pieces. Patch 5.0.5 added a chance to see pieces of these sets put up on the Black Market Auction House, with an opening bid of . This was the only way to acquire pieces until patch 10.1.5 added a new acquisition method.

Tier 15 is the armor set associated with Patch 5.2.0. It is obtained from the Throne of Thunder raid. All the tokens are turned in to Ao Pye at Niuzao Temple in the Townlong Steppes or Teng of the Flying Daggers in the Isle of Thunder.

Tigule's Harpoon is a rare polearm that is a decent weapon for hunters and possibly some paladins before getting Molten Core loot or an Ice Barbed Spear. It gives the user a stamina bonus, a hit rating increase, and an attack power increase when fighting beasts.
Tiki Dervish Ceremony is made by combining Yara's Sword with Tiri's Magical Incantation and Drek'Maz's Tiki.
__NOTOC__ Timeon is a night elf quest giver located at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

Tirisfal Camp Scroll is provided for The Silver Hand (quest) and Blade in Twilight. Using it teleports the player to Whispering Forest.
Tiny Toxic Blade is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Tooth of Eranikus is a Level 50 quality One-Handed Axe that improves Strength, Stamina and Critical Strike.
Tor'chunk Twoclaws is an orc quest giver located at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Toshley is a gnome quest giver who is in charge of Toshley's Station in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Torkus is an ogre mage quest giver located at Ogri'la in the Blade's Edge Mountains. He has 10 sons including Torkus Jr., Tork, and Torki.
Tork is an ogre mage located at Ogri'la in the Blade's Edge Mountains. He has 10 brothers including Torkus Jr. and Torki.
Torki is an ogre mage located at Ogri'la in the Blade's Edge Mountains. He has 10 brothers including Torkus Jr. and Tork.
Tortolla's Shield is a destroyer located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in or at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.
Toxin Injector is a gun with a bonus of attack power that drops from Grobbulus in Naxxramas with an estimated drop rate of 15%.

Originally intended as a mass-producted siege weapon that could be carried in a soldiers backpack, these catapults can be made to shrink to approximately a foot in size, enabling it to be easily packed away with its commander's gear. Unfortunately, they proved to fragile and expensive to truly catch on. One orcish army drained its entire treasury to create a kind of "catapult cavalry" unit equipped with these tiny weapons, only to lose the whole unit (and their weapons) in a single ambush. Unaware of their true powers, the victorious opponents took the "toys" home to their children. No one is sure how many of these items are now scattered around the world, gathering dust on a child's bedroom
Tracker's Spear is a starting item for Highmountain tauren hunters.
The Transitus Shield is a Kirin Tor outpost on the edge of Coldarra protected by a reflective shield hiding them from the Blue dragonflight.

.]] Transmogrification (commonly referred to as transmog, tmog, xmog or simply mog) provides the ability to replace the appearance of your armor and weapons with those of other items, or to hide certain pieces of armor. When a player earns or equips an item suitable for their class, the appearance of the item is added to their Appearances collection. Valid items whose appearance the player has not yet collected are highlighted in their tooltips. All soulbound items are automatically added to the player's transmog collection, as well as all quest rewards from completed quests, even if the player did not choose that reward. By visiting special NPCs, players can browse all available transmogs f

The Treated Ancient Blade has forged in dragonfire and tempered in the heart of one of the black dragonflight.
__NOTOC__ Tree Warden Chawn is a tauren quest giver located at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
__NOTOC__ :"We must save the trees, or soon all of Raven's Wood will be lost forever!" Treebole is a wandering Draenor ancient quest giver located at Raven's Wood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Trelopades can be summoned at Bash'ir Landing in Blade's Edge Mountains from a Ethereum Stasis Chamber.
Trihorn Shield is an ability used by direhorns during a Pet Battle.

Trogma's Claim is a cave next to Vekhaar Stand in southeastern Blade's Edge Mountains, controlled by the Vekh'nir arakkoa. It is riddled with draenethyst crystals, which are mined by enslaved ogres. The leader of the arakkoa tribe, Vekh, can be found in the mine. The mine is named after the ogre tribe's leader, Trogma, who has been enslaved by the arakkoa along with the others.
Trogma is an ogre found in Trogma's Claim, the area which carries his name, in the Blade's Edge Mountains. He and his tribe of ogres have all been enslaved by the arakkoa of Veil Vekh.
Tu'aho Pathcutter is a goblin who redeems Tier 16 Heroic mode armor tokens for Horde players in Shrine of Two Moons.

The Twilight's Hammer, also known as the Twilight's Hammer clan, Hammer clan, Twilight's Hammer cult, Twilight Cult, Cult of Twilight's Hammer or simply the Hammer, is a nihilist quasi-religious sect active across Azeroth that fanatically serves and worships the Old Gods and seeks to bring about the end of the world. Originally founded by Cho'gall as a clan of pale orcs, the cult has been active since before the First War but became a major worldwide threat to both the Alliance and the Horde after Deathwing's return and the great Cataclysm shattered Azeroth.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Acolytes are members of the Twilight's Hammer cult found in the Moonshrine Ruins in Blackfathom Deeps.
Tusker Sword has a very low probability to drop from level 40 - 52 mobs, often in instances.

Turalyon's Might is a battleship in the Alliance fleet that took part in the Siege of Orgrimmar,. It is the ship that Alliance adventurers arrive on once they teleport out from the Vault of Y'Shaarj with Jaina Proudmoore. It is presumably the flagship of the Alliance forces bearing down on Bladefist Bay as it is the ship that King Varian Wrynn is found on.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Loreseekers are members of the Twilight's Hammer cult found in the Moonshrine Ruins of Blackfathom Deeps.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Reavers are members of the Twilight's Hammer cult found in the Moonshrine Ruins of Blackfathom Deeps.

Twilight Precipice is a Twilight's Hammer camp found on the middle shelf in Deepholm, northeast of the Temple of Earth. This camp overlooks the Scoured Reach and Lorthuna's Gate to which it is also connected by a ramp. The cultists are led by three leaders, Boldrich Stonerender, High Priestess Lorthuna, and Zoltrik Drakebane. This camp becomes a battlefield when Therazane is convinced to destroy the cultists and remove all evidence of Deathwing from her plane.

__NOTOC__ The Twilight Citadel is the great fortress city of the Twilight's Hammer, located southeast of Grim Batol in the Twilight Highlands. The citadel is a massive area surrounding a spire. At the summit of its spire is the entrance to the Bastion of Twilight. The structure, much like the majority of Twilight architecture is constructed from elementium. The massive spire of the Citadel can be seen from as far away as Thelsamar in Loch Modan. The area was once the site of four Earthen Ring elemental portals similar to the Earthshrines, guarded by Earthcaller Yevaa. While the Ring was away helping to save Deepholm, the Twilight's Hammer moved in and corrupted the area. They then posted pow

Twilight Camp is an forward outpost of Twilight's Hammer clan in Loch Modan. The sky is dark and the ground is scorched and filled with the elementium spikes and characteristical architecture like the one found in Twilight Highlands above. In the camp there is a landshaping device that could devastate the region even further.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Riders are Twilight's Hammer drake riders found flying around the Eye of the Vortex in Darkshore.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Shadowmages are Forsaken members of the Twilight's Hammer cult found in Moonshrine Ruins in the Blackfathom Deeps. They are accompanied by Voidwalker Minions.

Twinks are player characters below the level cap who have gained the best powerful gear for their level with enhancements such as expensive weapon enchants, leg patches and BoE/BoP greens, blues or epics. Twinks are mainly used in PvP fighting and Battlegrounds. Twinks obtain their items through rare drops, drops off of bosses in instances, rewards from quests that are difficult to complete at their level, and from the Auction House. Twink items on the Auction House can be expensive and twink enchantments can only be performed by high-level characters. Therefore, twinking usually requires significant assistance from high-level alts, friends, and/or guild members. However, there are examples

Mekgineer Twizzleflux the Insane is a leper gnome in steam armor located at Starwatch Tower on top a cliff east of the Lost City of Tol'vir. He holds the access codes to the Expedition's Crawler Vehicle. A small group of Expedition Members can be found gathered in front of him. Twizzleflux will turn them into Cursed Expedition Members when approached.

The Twisted Mawstone is used by the Maw Walker as a monument to the fallen Knights of the Ebon Blade in the Crucible of the Damned of the Maw after their first foray to the Shadowlands in Through the Shattered Sky.

Unarmed can mean several things in World of Warcraft: # Fighting with no weapon. # The state of having no weapon equipped. The character uses fists as a weapon when no weapon is equipped. # A combat skill improved by melee fighting without a weapon or with a fist weapon. Unarmed combat is the weakest of all combat types. Why bother with it? Some enemies have the ability to disarm you and for a few seconds you'll be fighting unarmed. If you haven't built up your unarmed skill you'll be flailing at air. Unbound Ethereals are ethereals located in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Underworld Helm is an plate head armor. It gives bonuses to strength, agility, and stamina. It looks like a miner's helmet, but with a candle instead of a light.
The Unfired Ancient Blade has the potential to become a powerful weapon.
The Unholy Saber of the Ebon Blade is a quest reward from Death's Power Grows.
The Unholy Greatsword of the Ebon Blade is a quest reward from Death's Power Grows.

Unstable Flask of the Physician can be purchased for from Aether-tech Assistant in Blade's Edge Mountains. There are 6 Unstable Flasks available.
Unstable Flask of the Bandit can be purchased for from Aether-tech Assistant in Blade's Edge Mountains. There are 6 Unstable Flasks available.
Unstable Flask of the Soldier can be purchased for from Aether-tech Assistant in Blade's Edge Mountains. There are 6 Unstable Flasks available.

Unstable Flasks are flask elixirs that can only be used in Blade's Edge Mountains and Gruul's Lair, and are as such designed to help groups defeating Gruul the Dragonkiller - especially on their first visits to the Lair, as the flask effects persists through Death. There are 6 Unstable Flasks available:
Unsinkable is a piece of naval equipment that acts as a one-time shield if a ship would otherwise be destroyed after a failed naval Garrison Mission.
Unstable Fel-Imps are fel imps that can be found at Death's Door in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Unquenchable Blade is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
__NOTOC__ Urumir Stavebright is a blood elf staff vendor located on the Scryer's Tier in Shattrath City.
Unwavering Legguards are plate armor legs sold by G'eras in Shattrath City for .

Uroe, Harbinger of Terror is a battle axe infused with the power of lightning. It was used by Lei Shen, the Thunder King, during his reign as emperor. After his death it was lost in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. It was found by adventurers aligned with the Golden Lotus before being stolen by the forces of Zhao-Jin the Bloodletter and returned to the recently resurrected Thunder King. Lei Shen used the axe in the first and third phases of his final battle.
The Vaesska is a sunken ship in Vashj'ir. Zithreenai naga were encountered there by champions of the Valarjar. It transported powerful armaments.
Valiant Sword is sold by Erunak Stonespeaker in Kelp'thar Forest and Iris Moondreamer in Mount Hyjal for .
Valorous Shield is a continent drop from level 45 - 53 Eastern Kingdoms mobs.
The Vambraces of the Naaru are plate armor bracers sold by G'eras in Shattrath City for .
Vek'lor's Gloves of Devastation are mail hand armor for dps classes.
Veenix is a goblin weapon vendor located on the western edge of Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. He was a freewheeling trader friendly to both Alliance and Horde.
Veil Ruuan is located in the northern part of Ruuan Weald in Blade's Edge Mountains, home to a tribe of arakkoa.

Vekhaar Stand is a forested glade located in southeastern Blade's Edge Mountains. It houses the Mok'Nathal Village and Veil Vekh, and has two cave openings leading into Trogma's Claim and Death's Door. It is roamed by passive maggots and aggressive moths.
__NOTOC__ Vekh'nir Dreadhawks are arakkoa found in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Vekh is an arakkoa found in Trogma's Claim in the Blade's Edge Mountains. He is the leader of the Vekh'nir arakkoa which have enslaved all the ogres of the area.
The Vekh'nir Crystal drop from the following arakkoa in Blade's Edge Mountains: *Vekh'nir Stormcaller *Vekh'nir Keeneye *Vekh'nir Dreadhawk *Vekh'nir Matriarch
Vekh'nir Keeneyes are arakkoa found in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Vekh'nir Matriarchs are arakkoa found in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Vekh'nir Stormcallers are arakkoa found in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

The Vekh'nir are a group of arakkoa found at Trogma's Claim and Veil Vekh in Blade's Edge Mountains. They have been benign for many years, but now something has stirred them. They have been a thorn in Mok'Nathal's sides for many years. Some strange religion guides them, a religion which has them in a frenzy of activity. They carry some crystals with them now, which they have turned to some dark purpose. Some of their rituals consist on taking the crystals to their spell circles to infuse them. They have enslaved a group of ogres in the caverns known as Trogma's Claim and their leader, Vekh is in there.

Vim'gol's Circle is the dark home of Vim'gol the Vile in northeastern Blade's Edge Mountains. The circle lies just before the entrance to Netherstorm, and summoning Vim'gol is done by having one player stand in each of the five circles of fire.

A weapon master is an NPC that offers characters the opportunity to learn specific weapon skills, the availability of which varies from one weapon master to another. All weapon skills can be trained at level 1 and cost , except for Polearms which require level 20 and cost . Training with a weapon master became obsolete in Patch 4.0.1, as all class-appropriate weapon proficiencies are now learned by each class upon creation. Weapon masters were removed from the game shortly after.

Weapon glows are glowing effects that typically appears on enchanted weapons. While some weapon glows are intrinsic effects on magical weapons (these organic glows cannot be overridden by enchantments), most weapon glows that you might see are from enchantments. This page lists the glows players can apply to weapons with the help of enchanters. It is designed to help players (especially new players) determine the relative cost, brightness, and color of all available glows. It is worth noting that glows do not look the same on all computers. The signature item of the "wizard" Zecker was his staff — Zecker's Firestaff, also known as Zecker's Staff of the Elements. Six feet of polished wood bound in silver and gems, the staff could shoot a jet of flame on command and just as quickly snuff a roaring campfire. It could release a bolt of lightning or a peal of thunder. It allowed Zecker to walk through the air as though clouds were stone. The iron globe clutched next to the blade mounted at the staffs tip could glow as brightly as a star, shedding warmth and light, or it could absorb heat until the surrounding area was sheathed in ice. A blade of Quel'Serrar is a special type of ancient weapon. A blade of Quel'Serrar has to be crafted in a ceremony with a dragon, who has to willingly heat and mold the enchanted metal with their breath, and then also needs to contain the fury of their own enchantment by using their blood as temper. Over the course of 8,000 years, only a handful of these blades were created - each blade unique in both power and appearance. The blades would take on the characteristics of their draconic creator. In addition to those blades infused with the essence of a single dragon are the Prismatic Blades, legendary weapons created with the combined might of the five Dragon Aspects.
